dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: You have good taste, my friend! Miss Odette's choreography always carries a sense of martial restraint.

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: Many performers, when expressing intense emotion, tend to fall into chaotic physical excess... but she is different.

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: Some of my fellow critics — though forgive my bluntness, they truly understand nothing — love to compare her with her mother and analyze the similarities between their styles...

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: But from a truly professional standpoint, Madame Violetta's style leans toward absolute classical restraint, whereas Miss Odette....

dialogues.speaker: Pisemsky
dialogues.text: Ah, never mind. True art should be felt, not explained. What words cannot convey should simply remain in silence!
